errors.text_span: with the largest gap observed in KoBEST-CP (0.74 vs. 0.71) and the smallest in PT-EVAL (0.46 vs. 0.42)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the largest and smallest performance gaps. The gap in KoBEST-CP is 0.03 (0.74 - 0.71), which is the smallest gap. The gap in PT-EVAL is 0.04 (0.46 - 0.42), which is tied for the largest gap. The description inverts these facts.
